motion.purpose: Single horizontal image reveal in the first viewport.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The main portfolio or consultation action.

components.name: Evidence Strip
components.description: Compact water, power, tenure, and security facts.

narrative.overview: Property is presented as something inspected, documented, and understood—not merely advertised. Architectural photography supplies emotion while survey-like rules, compact evidence rows, and restrained editorial typography supply confidence.
keyCharacteristics: Forest survey surfaces with warm paper notes
Fine rules and sparse bronze emphasis
One deliberate reveal rather than scattered motion

rules.name: The Evidence Accent Rule
rules.body: Bronze appears on actions and decision-critical details; it is never used as general decoration.

rules.name: The Six-Rem Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Display copy never exceeds 6rem and keeps tracking no tighter than -0.035em.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Cards and controls use either a rule or a shadow, never both for routine decoration.

dos: Do lead with title, water, power, security, land, or locality evidence.
Do use one strong image at meaningful scale.
Do preserve asymmetry and calm negative space.
donts: Don't use generic luxury gradients, decorative gold flourishes, or equal card towers as the page thesis.
Don't add eyebrow text above headings.
Don't use monospace outside identifiers, measurements, and data.
